scope: reference-e2e durable stage checkpointing and restart recovery
source_of_truth: existing reference-e2e stage functions and state machine

persistence.checkpoint_commit_boundary: one committed immutable checkpoint after each completed legal stage
binds: artifact identity and SHA-256 when present
audit event identity and SHA-256 when present
persistence.mutation: UPDATE and DELETE rejected by database trigger

recovery.strategy: hydrate exact durable prefix and continue from first incomplete stage
recovery.finalization: completed ASSURED result is archived through existing PostgreSQL Runtime Evidence Persistence v0.1

explicit_non_goals: automatic takeover of an actively running healthy process
